summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Lunar Coins Tebex store in LIVE mode with valid public token. All 6 backend pytest tests pass and every requested frontend flow works: 7 real Tebex packages render with real CDN images, auto badges (BELIEBT/BESTER WERT) show, Discord banner links to discord.gg, community widgets render (top-customer fallback + 2 recent payments), cart add/qty/remove works, and checkout redirects to https://ident.tebex.io/fivem?... as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/store LIVE path correctly flattens Tebex categories, dedupes by pkg id, extracts numeric coin count from name, strips HTML from description, and falls back to demo store on any Tebex failure. Good.
server.py /api/basket/create creates basket via Headless API and fetches FiveM auth URLs; returns clean JSON with ident + auth_urls. Good.
server.py /api/basket/add correctly returns HTTP 400 with clear German error if Tebex call fails; ObjectId not exposed.
CoinGrid.withBadges: auto-assigns best_value to highest coins/price ratio (correctly picked 11000 Coins / 99.99€ = 110.11 c/€) and popular to index[1] (1000 Coins). Deterministic.
CartDrawer.startCheckout properly persists pending items to localStorage, uses auth_urls[0].url first then falls back to links.checkout.
CommunityWidget: Avatar has onError -> initials fallback, referrerPolicy=no-referrer. Good.
Minor: badge text is CSS uppercased via Tailwind (text-[11px] uppercase) - source strings 'Bester Wert'/'Beliebt' render as 'BESTER WERT'/'BELIEBT'. Test suite normalizes with .upper().
test_credentials: N/A - no auth. Tebex LIVE token in backend/.env (TEBEX_PUBLIC_TOKEN=117um-...).
seed_data_creation: None. Real Tebex data pulled from headless.tebex.io.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Store is LIVE. GET /api/store -> demo=false, webstore.name='Lunar', 7 packages with numeric int ids (7216680, 7216683, 7216681, 7216686, 7216687, 7216691, 7229362) and real Tebex CDN image URLs (dunb17ur4ymx4.cloudfront.net). Coin/price map verified: [(475,4.99),(1000,9.99),(2050,19.99),(3650,34.99),(5350,49.99),(11000,99.99),(27500,249.99)]. /api/sidebar returns modules with types [textbox, top_customer, recent_payments]; top_customer.data currently null (no top customer yet). /api/basket/create returns ident + auth_urls[0].url starting with https://ident.tebex.io/fivem?return=...&signature=... . Frontend badge text is CSS-uppercased - assert case-insensitively. Redirect target (ident.tebex.io) presents a Cloudflare bot check which is expected/OK; DO NOT try to complete external payment.
